title: CSS Font Loading Module Level 3
author: W3C CSSWG; Tab Atkins Jr.
claim: ready resolves after font/layout loading; check can succeed for fallback or missing names.
decision: Explicitly load pinned FontFace and inspect glyph coverage, not only document.fonts.check.
limitation: A resolved promise does not prove correct brand font or all Polish glyphs.
test: Missing font and missing ą fixture must fail preflight.
rights: W3C document licence; no font asset supplied

title: Time Ranges
author: OpenTimelineIO contributors
claim: Clip source and parent ranges are different coordinate systems; transitions extend visible range.
decision: Store local source time and assigned global interval separately.
limitation: OTIO interchange does not establish shader or AE effect compatibility.
test: Boundary out is excluded; handles must be available.
rights: Documentation rights require upstream review for copying; original synthesis only

title: opentimelineio.opentime
author: OpenTimelineIO contributors
claim: RationalTime measures value/rate seconds; exclusive and inclusive duration differ.
decision: Use integer numerator/denominator at contract boundary and explicit rounding.
limitation: API name RationalTime does not itself guarantee exact fraction arithmetic internally.
test: Frames 10..14 count5, not6; Fraction test for 30000/1001.

title: librosa.beat.beat_track
author: librosa contributors; method Daniel P. W. Ellis
claim: Beat estimation combines onset strength and tempo consistency; time-varying bpm input is supported.
decision: Keep beat candidate, onset and downbeat as different event kinds.
limitation: Default units are analysis frames, not video frames; empty onset strength yields empty beats.
test: Synthetic samples map to video frames; real listening NOT_RUN.
rights: Documentation/code rights separate from example audio; none downloaded

title: librosa.onset.onset_detect
author: librosa contributors
claim: Onsets are peak-picked; backtrack moves to preceding energy minimum.
decision: Choose attack impact versus segmentation boundary explicitly.
limitation: A backtracked slice point is not automatically perceptual musical accent.
test: Compare onset/impact annotations on actual audio later.
rights: No code or audio assets copied

title: PROV Model Primer
author: W3C; Yolanda Gil, Simon Miles (editors)
claim: Entities, activities, agents and derivation/revision are distinct.
decision: Record hash/revision and derivation graph; invalidate affected approvals.
limitation: PROV does not prescribe Studio approval policy.
test: Asset revision invalidates only dependants, preserving prior evidence.
rights: W3C document-use terms; conceptual adaptation only

title: Premult
author: Foundry
version: Nuke live docs; exact version Unknown
claim: Nuke Merge expects premultiplied images; color correction can require unpremult/correct/premult.
decision: Tag alpha domain and test edge composites.
limitation: Alpha-zero behavior and other renderers need explicit policy; not every operation needs unpremult.
rights: Proprietary documentation; short paraphrase, no assets copied

title: Caching simulations
author: SideFX
claim: RAM cache can evict frames; SOP geometry caches and DOP simulation state caches differ.
decision: Distinguish render cache, geometry bake and resumable solver state.
limitation: A rendered image does not restore solver state; background caching settings differ.
test: Seek and resume from checkpoint with pinned seed/version; NOT_RUN.

title: MoGraph Cache
author: Maxon
locator: MoGraph Cache description and use cases
claim: Cache records clone transforms with effectors; proxy collisions are approximate.
decision: Use stable instance IDs and explicit baked motion state.
limitation: Proxy geometry can have different collision boundaries.
test: Delete one clone and inspect stable identity; NOT_RUN
rights: Proprietary documentation; conceptual adaptation only, no code/assets copied

title: Combining behaviors with keyframes in Motion
author: Apple
version: Live guide, exact app version Unknown
claim: Behavior contributions and keyframes combine with a defined order.
decision: Separate authored path and procedural modulation in specification.
limitation: Arbitrary behavior names cannot guarantee backend semantic parity.
test: Check effect of changing modulation alone; NOT_RUN
rights: Proprietary documentation; conceptual adaptation only, no code/assets copied
